object.content: Today I finally got in my 17mm PCB header strips from an eBay order that I placed over a month ago. You can see from the first picture that they are a tad bit longer than typical headers. I got these so I could finally put a header on my 16x2 character LCD. I wanted the longer ones so I had the option of using female-to-female jumper wires (which I love) or a breadboard to connect the LCD to a circuit. They turned out to be just the right length to do either option. It took me a few tries to figure out the best way to solder these in, but in the end, it was best just to stick the soldering iron in between the headers so I could heat the pad up in front and behind the header to get the solder to stick the best.
